question: How much did Oligo raise in its latest funding round?

hits.title: Oligo Raises $60M to extend runtime security to AI agents.
hits.snippet: [invests_into | 2026-08-13 | $60 million] Greenfield Growth invested into Oligo Security Ltd. $60M in Series B on Aug 13th '26. Oligo, founded in 2022, employs 129 people and has raised $140 million, having previously completed a $50 million Series B funding round in January 2025 led by Greenfield Partners.
